who: Leonard H. D. Gordon, historian of China and Taiwan, Wisconsin faculty member in 1963–1967 and subsequently at Purdue; doctorate Michigan 1961.

LC identifies Leonard H. D. Gordon through Taiwan (1970), whose author information describes him as associate professor of Chinese history at Purdue.

notes: The Wisconsin appointment covers the students' 1963 and 1967 dissertation years. The later Purdue appointment and Taiwan publication link the supervisor to nr89001640 among the supplied namesakes.
